bill.constitutionalAuthorityStatementText:
[Congressional Record Volume 165, Number 75 (Tuesday, May 7, 2019)]
[House]
From the Congressional Record Online through the Government Publishing Office [www.gpo.gov]
By Mr. FLORES:
H.R. 2536.
Congress has the power to enact this legislation pursuant
to the following:
Article 1, Section 8, Clause 1 of the Constitution of the
United States: ``The Congress shall have power to lay and
collect taxes, duties, imposts and excises, to pay the debts
and provide for the common defense and general welfare of the
United States; but all duties, imposts and excises shall be
uniform throughout the United States.''
[Page H3475]
